llm.summary: The skill is mainly an Apple jobs lookup tool, but its bundled helper can use the Crawlora API key for broader, under-disclosed API requests beyond Apple job postings.

dimensions.detail: Using a Crawlora API key for public Apple job data is proportionate, but the undocumented CRAWLORA_API_BASE override can redirect authenticated requests and disclose the API key if the runtime environment is influenced.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install hook, package manager action, dependency installation, or automatic setup behavior was found; the artifact is documentation plus a curl-based shell helper.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and reference/endpoints.md describe only two read-only Apple Jobs endpoints, while the helper accepts caller-controlled paths, POST bodies, and non-GET methods without an allowlist.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, local credential-store access, privilege escalation, background worker, memory writes, or destructive local filesystem behavior was observed.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The documented purpose is narrow Apple Jobs research, but artifact/scripts/crawlora.sh is a generic Crawlora REST helper with examples for Amazon, YouTube, Google search, and Google Trends, and it supports arbitrary paths and methods.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill before installing. Use it only with a Crawlora key you are comfortable limiting to this workflow, avoid setting CRAWLORA_API_BASE, and prefer a version that hardcodes the Crawlora base URL and allowlists only /apple-jobs/search and /apple-jobs/job.
llm.findings:
[TP4] unexpected: The broad helper capability is supported by artifact text and code, but this is a scope and disclosure concern rather than evidence of malicious tool poisoning.
[SDI-1] unexpected: The generic helper examples and arbitrary API path handling are not needed for the Apple Jobs-only purpose described in SKILL.md.
[SDI-1] unexpected: The code concatenates caller-supplied paths onto the API base and permits non-GET requests, expanding authority beyond the two documented Apple Jobs GET endpoints.
[T09] unexpected: The static finding is supported: CRAWLORA_API_BASE is not documented in SKILL.md and the script sends the x-api-key header to whatever base URL is supplied through that environment variable.
